name: dox2U
description_en: dox2U is a hosted document workspace from Privet Ventures. It combines tagged documents, filtered Smart Cabinets and Dockets that group related records around a transaction or process. Viewing, editing, deletion and guest sharing have separate rights and ownership conditions. Its current annual plan cards and capacity table differ from older indexed pricing and from legacy help terminology, so features and fees need a current plan check.
description_zh: dox2U 是 Privet Ventures 的托管文档工作区，将带标签文档、可筛选 Smart Cabinet 和围绕交易或流程组织相关记录的 Docket 结合。查看、编辑、删除及访客共享各有权限和所有权条件。当前年度套餐卡片及容量表与旧索引价格和帮助术语不同，因此功能及费用需按当前套餐核对。

sections.title_en: Use a collection identifier before judging completeness
sections.title_zh: 判断完整性前先确定集合标识
sections.en:
Dockets group documents by a transaction, project or process and expose document checklists. Smart Cabinet instead offers a dynamic filtered view over workspace documents, with effective tag filtering dependent on correct labels and values. A full checklist is useful for finding missing items, but does not establish that each uploaded file is accurate or belongs to the selected business event.

For an editorial evaluation, create a synthetic shipment with one shipment ID and three expected records: invoice, packing list and delivery evidence. Include a duplicate invoice and a certificate for a different shipment. Ask an operator to find the collection, identify what is missing and inspect each source rather than merely count files. Define who may correct tags and who decides the packet is accepted. The dedicated Dockets link returned no readable body; detailed collection permissions and correction behavior remain unverified. No document or collection was created.
sections.zh:
Docket 按交易、项目或流程组织文档并显示清单；Smart Cabinet 则提供工作区文档的动态筛选视图，有效标签筛选依赖正确标签和值。完整清单有助于发现缺项，却不确立每份上传文件准确或属于所选业务事件。

编辑建议的评估可用虚构货运，设置一个货运标识及三类预期记录：发票、装箱单和交付证明。包含重复发票及另一批货物的证书，让操作员找到集合、辨认缺项并检查各来源，不只数文件。还需明确谁能纠正标签，谁决定材料包可接受。专门 Dockets 链接未返回可读正文，详细集合权限和纠正行为未核实。本研究未创建文档或集合。

sections.title_en: Do not equate a shared document with every action right
sections.title_zh: 不要将共享访问等同全部操作权限
sections.en:
The help separates workspace roles from action rights such as download/print, edit, delete and guest sharing. Viewing requires ownership or shared access. The legacy Edit article describes opening a tab and note, tag or name-related actions; it does not establish full native-file editing, exclusive locks or a version-recovery procedure. The owner/verifier selection and upload-verification articles are placeholders.

For the synthetic shipment, define an uploader, record owner and reviewer, then inspect the intended actions independently. Check whether a shared reviewer can download, retag, delete or pass access onward before using real material. A displayed “verified” label should be tied to a documented review decision and source, not treated as platform certification or legal authenticity. Record the unanswered ownership-transfer and review-reset questions instead of assuming a title in the help navigation describes an implemented feature. No role, ownership, verification or edit operation was performed.
sections.zh:
帮助将工作区角色与下载打印、编辑、删除和访客共享等操作权限分开；查看需要所有权或共享访问。旧 Edit 文章描述打开标签页及备注、标签和名称相关动作，没有确立完整原生文件编辑、排他锁或版本恢复方法。选择所有者验证者及上传验证文章仍是占位说明。

虚构货运应定义上传者、记录所有者及审查者，再分别检查目标动作。在用真实材料前，需确认共享审查者能否下载、改标签、删除或继续共享。显示“已验证”应对应有记录的审查决定和来源，不能当作平台认证或法律真实性。所有权转移及审查重置问题需明确保留，不能因帮助导航有标题就假定功能已被说明。本研究未执行角色、所有权、验证或编辑。

sections.title_en: A guest link needs both entitlement and an access rule
sections.title_zh: 访客链接同时需要套餐权益及访问规则
sections.en:
The guest guide describes sharing with external email recipients without making them workspace members, with duration-based or manual revocation and a separate guest-sharing right. It describes one document per share operation. However, the same page names both Pro and Enterprise as required plans, while the current cards use Business-family names. Its entitlement labels should not override the current plan or order.

For the synthetic delivery evidence, identify the recipient, allowed action and expiry before evaluating a share. Confirm what the guest can view or download and inspect the owner’s revocation path. A message reaching an address is separate from an intended person reviewing the right revision. Do not treat the guide’s screenshot-prevention claim as proof that no recipient can capture information by another means. Current OTP behavior, copy recall and post-restore sharing state were not established. No email, message, link or invitation was sent.
sections.zh:
访客指南描述无需加入工作区即可向外部邮箱共享，可按时间或手动撤销，并需独立访客共享权限；每次共享操作针对一份文档。但同页同时将 Pro 和 Enterprise 写成所需套餐，当前卡片则使用 Business 系列名称，因此旧权益标签不能覆盖当前套餐或订单。

虚构交付证据在评估共享前，应明确收件人、允许动作及期限，确认访客能查看或下载什么，并检查所有者撤销路径。消息送达某邮箱，与目标人员审查正确修订不同。不能把指南阻止截图主张当作收件人无法通过其他方式捕获信息的证明。当前 OTP 行为、副本收回及恢复后的共享状态未确立。本研究未发送邮件、消息、链接或邀请。

sections.title_en: Find the document owner before seeking recovery
sections.title_zh: 寻求恢复前先确定文档所有者
sections.en:
The deletion guide sends a shared document deleted by an authorized colleague to the document owner’s trash. My Queue is an important exception: the guide describes permanent deletion there, as well as from Trash. The owner’s restore action returns an item to its original location. Permanent deletion is not reversible through that procedure; re-uploading is not the same as restoring its old record history.

For the proposed shipment, assign a recovery owner before testing an accidental removal. Check the active workspace trash duration and whether an administrator may empty it earlier. Then verify the returned file, tags, access and Docket association separately. The public guide still refers to billed dPages, whereas current pricing uses storage allowances; do not build a current invoice estimate from that old term. Exact backup recovery, preserved sharing and automatic review behavior after restore remain unverified. No document was deleted, purged, re-uploaded or restored.
sections.zh:
删除指南说明，获授权同事删除共享文档后，会进入该文档所有者的回收站。My Queue 是重要例外：指南描述可在该处及 Trash 永久删除。所有者恢复会把项目送回原位置；永久删除不能通过此流程撤销，重新上传也不等于恢复原记录历史。

建议货运样例测试误移除前，应指定恢复责任人，检查当前工作区回收站期限及管理员是否可提前清空。之后分别核对文件、标签、访问和 Docket 关联。公开指南仍提到计费 dPages，但当前价格使用存储额度，不能按旧术语估算当前账单。精确备份恢复、共享保留及恢复后自动审查行为未核实。本研究未删除、清除、重新上传或恢复文档。

sections.title_en: Separate the included user from additional annual seats
sections.title_zh: 区分所含用户与追加年度席位
sections.en:
The actual browser shows annual base cards of $60 Starter, $90 Business, $150 Business Plus and $190 Teams. Each includes one user; additional users cost $20/$30/$45 per year on the three team-capable plans. Starter is single-user. The billing FAQ says prepaid annual billing with prorated charges for users added during the term. Currency code, regional eligibility, taxes and final checkout were not established, and older INR search amounts are not converted or substituted.

For a hypothetical three-person Business workspace, the displayed annual components total $130 before unverified taxes or usage charges: $90 plus two $20 users. This is arithmetic, not a quote. Free is one user with 2 GB and a 10 MB document cap, not a trial of every paid feature. Dockets/OCR and log scope need plan checks; API credits and dCoins are different usage concepts whose current fee mechanics were not established. No checkout or trial was started.
sections.zh:
实际浏览器年度基础卡片为 Starter $60、Business $90、Business Plus $150、Teams $190，每款含一用户；可组队的后三款追加用户分别为每年 $20/$30/$45。Starter 仅单用户。计费 FAQ 说明预付年费，周期内增员按剩余时间比例计费。币种代码、地区资格、税及最终结账未确立，不换算或替代为旧 INR 搜索金额。

假设三人 Business 工作区，页面年度组成在未核税及用量费前合计 $130，即 $90 加两位 $20。这是算例，不是报价。Free 为一用户、2 GB、单文档 10 MB，并非所有付费功能试用。Docket、OCR 和日志范围需查套餐；API credits 与 dCoins 是不同用量概念，当前费率机制未确立。本研究未启动结账或试用。

sections.title_en: Export before access ends and verify the usable result
sections.title_zh: 访问结束前导出并验证可用结果
sections.en:
The current legal landing redirects to livesite.dox2u.com and links the April 2022 customer terms and April 2023 EULA. The latter retains software title and restricts modification and redistribution; a free hosted plan is not an open-source grant. Customer terms describe non-renewal notice at least 30 days before the term ends, generally non-refundable paid commitments with specified exceptions, and loss of access at termination.

Those terms call for customer-data deletion within 30 days after expiry or termination and permit immediate account deactivation. That is not a 30-day export-access grace period. Export availability also depends on subscription and settings. For the shipment pilot, define an exit sample containing readable files, accepted tags and relationships, then check the result while access remains available. The privacy policy separately discusses Customer Data, account/usage information and third-party integrations; it is not a guarantee of a complete application restore. Exact current order precedence, backup erasure and export fidelity remain unverified. No cancellation, export or agreement acceptance occurred.
sections.zh:
当前法律入口跳转至 livesite.dox2u.com，链接 2022 年 4 月客户条款和 2023 年 4 月 EULA。后者保留软件所有权，限制修改及再分发，因此免费托管套餐不是开源授权。客户条款描述至少在周期结束前 30 天通知不续期、已付承诺通常不退款但有特定例外，以及终止后失去访问。

条款规定到期或终止后 30 天内删除客户数据，并允许立即停用账户，这不是 30 天导出访问宽限。导出能力还依赖订阅及设置。货运试点应定义含可读文件、已接受标签及关系的退出样本，并在仍可访问时检查。隐私政策另述 Customer Data、账户用量信息和第三方集成，不保证完整应用恢复。当前订单优先级、备份擦除及导出保真未核实。本研究未取消、导出或接受协议。
